caseNameFull: Mathias Et Al. v. WorldCom Technologies, Inc., Et Al.

opinions.text: C. A. 7th Cir. [Certiorari granted; 532 U. S. 903.] Motions of respondents WorldCom Technologies, Inc., et al. and Illinois Bell Telephone Co., dba Ameritech Illinois, for leave to file supplemental briefs after argument granted.
